boundary: Frozen F9J2 CPU integer offline analysis only. No training or release changes. Canonical grouped exploratory folds are not model-held-out/OOD; domain already fitted and audited.
baseline_gate: Verify all 69 RESEARCH-SNAPSHOT evidence digests, every saved stage on all 627 canonical boards, complete legal sets and original-coordinate ties on all 4520 nonterminal raw boards before interventions.
folds: Existing seed1729 ply-stratified canonical-grouped 60/20/remaining train/validation/test. No symmetry copy independence. All selection uses train only; validation and test reported separately, no tuning.
labels: Existing independent board geometry labels. Fork prevention is bounded one-reply viable-reply audit, not a general strategy oracle. Minimax only offline optimal-set/move audits.

necessity.units: All 16 expert hidden units (4 experts x4 units), after GELU, post-routing; unselected cells unobserved.
necessity.arithmetic: round_div(integer activation * numerator,4), existing signed rounding; no weight writes.
necessity.training_contrast: Among 15 units excluding E1.h0, maximize training must-block nonoptimal-move rate minus training fork nonoptimal-move rate. Ties lexicographic expert/unit. Negative findings retained.
groups: E1.h0+contrast next unit modulo4 matched-expert control
necessity.interaction: Full-zero pair move/set damage compared with union of single failures and additive signed-logit difference. Not probabilistic causal mediation.

donors.donors: training canonical boards only; different board; one deterministic nearest donor per receiver/task/class
donors.nearest: minimum canonical board Hamming occupancy distance, then maximum absolute gate delta, then canonical index. No matching on outcomes or activation values. No fallback if absent.
donors.alignment: Both boards are canonical NN inputs. Same expert ID, same hidden-unit coordinate; gates retained from receiver. No assumed semantic neuron rotation. Save canonical boards, raw-to-canonical transforms, donor IDs and distances.
donors.restriction: Patch only when expert is routed in both; inactive is unobserved, never donor zero. Coverage is a primary result; low coverage narrows claims.

mediation.selection: Training only: halve each norm2_output lane; select lane with maximum mean absolute change in E1.h0 among rows routed E1 before and after. No labels/outcomes used for lane selection.
mediation.followup: Selected upstream half-dose alone; restore baseline E1.h0, contrast, or both where corresponding expert observed in both routes. Record route/gate changes, covered rescue and newly introduced damage. Identity restoration under upstream no-op is checked.
mediation.interpretation: Restoration conditional on observed routes is path-specific intervention, not identified natural indirect effect. Upstream lesion may reroute; downstream lesions/patches must not.

metrics: Raw4520 and canonical627, fold/class/active counts; empty sets, selected nonoptimal moves, complete-set differences, optimal equivalent-tie changes. Geometry/routing matched non-target covered error rates and denominators. Canonical units of evidence, raw symmetry expansion descriptive only. Retain all cases, negative effects, counterexamples, exact logits/routes/gates.
selection_timing: This manifest is fixed before any new intervention evaluation; baseline parity is a prerequisite. No adaptive candidate/group expansion.
reproduction: Run scripts/model_strategy_study003.py --output artifacts/interpretability/study-003 then same command with a fresh output path; compare deterministic files byte-for-byte. Renderer uses saved measurements only.
